note.text: The dental treatment visit (three months after the well-child referral). Dr. Watson already has Timothy's medical record from the Interaction 2 pre-encounter push via Connie. This encounter is where UC03's prior-authorization machinery fires: the planned scaling and root planing (D4341) requires PA under HUSKY B, so CRD/DTR/PAS run here (see the PA-cycle resources in this interaction), unlike the covered-evaluation referral at Interaction 1 which triggered no CRD.
